# Dependency refresh — 2026-10-04

All installed direct dependencies, tooling overrides, and GitHub Actions are at
the latest stable releases checked on 2026-10-04. Bun remains at its latest
1.4.2. Package versions and internal references remain 2.17.3.

The major updates include Size Limit 14.1.0 and Mermaid 12.1.0. Size Limit uses
its esbuild/file plugins to preserve the existing CSS-inclusive budgets. Mermaid
uses Dagre/classic styling; the docs browser floor is Safari/iOS Safari 17.4+.
The public React support ranges remain unchanged; React 17/18 fixture pins
exercise those compatibility contracts rather than selecting the workspace's
installed React version (19.3.0).

## Upstream constraints

The npm registry was checked for all 1,689 unique names in the regenerated Bun
lockfile. The table covers 665 older name/version pairs across 596 package names
(746 separate lockfile instances). Each has a published upstream dependency or
peer range that excludes the latest stable release. Multiple versions can remain
when different upstream packages require incompatible ranges. No direct major
update is deferred. Upgrading these held copies requires their upstream parents
to publish compatible dependency ranges; the exact blocking parent versions and
ranges are recorded below. Compatible parents are omitted from this table.

The remaining `braces` advisory GHSA-vfj7-8cjw-p6xm affects npm's latest 3.0.3;
there is no published patched version to install. The esbuild advisory is
resolved by the tested 0.28.2 override.
